name: CI with gz-physics

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0' # Weekly

  build_and_test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential cmake git libeigen3-dev libboost-all-dev

      - name: Build and install dart
        run: |
          mkdir -p build
          cd build
          cmake .. -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr/local
          make -j$(nproc)
          sudo make install

      - name: Checkout gz-physics repository

          repository: gazebosim/gz-physics
          ref: v0.9.0
          path: gz-physics

          mkdir -p gz-physics/build
          cd gz-physics/build
          cmake .. -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
          make -j$(nproc)

      - name: Run dart tests

          cd build
